  • 英語名: Gamen kara Detekita Oshi Vtuber to H na Dousei Seikatsu Kemo Mimi Game Haishinsha wa Downer-kei.

あらすじ

Masato Kasakabe has a miserable job that’s constantly overworking him.

His sole pleasure is supporting his favorite vtubers.

“Ahh, if only my oshi jumped through the screen right now…”

But that could never happen for real…

item.title: Linker Bell Academia ~Rakudai Majo to Himitsu no Gishiki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Casket
  • 発売日: 2021-08-27
  • スコア: 6.82/10 (28 人評価)
  • 日本語名: リンカーベル・アカデミア～落第魔女とヒミツの儀式～
  • 英語名: Linker Bell Academia Rakudai Majo to Himitsu no Gishiki

别名

  • Bellaca

あらすじ

Misaki Hiro is normal student without any special trait or talent. One day, he is suddenly sent to a different world filled with magic by a mysterious goddess. His first meeting in the new world is with Eros Strobel who is student of all-girls magic school. Since his appearance overlaps with her summoning magic, she treats him as her familiar and has him stay at the school. There he meets up with her friends: the lazy senior human-beast Hibiki Flamel and stoic but kind Melusine Dragonette from the Dragon tribe.

  • 英語名: Iegami Nyoubou Koisuru Inaba wa Kinpatsu Usagi

あらすじ
